literal: Village pond water having filled like that indeed world desires great wisdom man's wealth.
translation: The wealth of a man of great wisdom, whom the world loves, is like a village drinking pond filling with water.
modern: உலகம் விரும்பும் பேரறிவாளனிடம் உள்ள செல்வமானது, ஊரின் நடுவே உள்ள குடிநீர்க் குளம் நீரால் நிறைந்தது போன்றதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet compares the wealth of a wise and benevolent person to a village drinking pond full of water. A village pond is accessible to everyone and quenches the thirst of the whole community without discrimination. Similarly, when a person of great wisdom acquires wealth, they use it for the benefit of all, making them beloved by the world. The word 'பேரறிவாளன்' highlights that true wisdom naturally leads to such generous benevolence.
